title: Water Lilies
overview: Hyo-won, who dreams of becoming an actress, arrives at Seoul city after running away from country home with Eun-seo, who dropped out of high school. They are excited with their own hopes for the future.  Hyo-won starts taking acting lessons from leading actor Su-yeon to become a member of the theater company. Eun-seo starts to work at a shabby restaurant when Hyo-won's lesson fee is urgent.  Su-yeon teaches Hyo-won. Acting... It's about fully understanding and expressing other people's pain.  But Hyo-won doesn't understand Eun-seo's pain. The same goes for Eun-seo.  Life is full of questions for them

title: Olmo
overview: Olmo just wants to be a normal teenager and hang out with his best friend, but he must help care for his bedridden father. When Olmo gets invited to a party by his beautiful neighbor, he will do whatever he can to meet up with her while embarking on an adventure of mischief, laughs, and chaos. As the night unfolds, he may come to love the very place he's spent so long trying to escape: his home.

title: Little Dreamerz
overview: Gun-woo, drowning in a failing business, meets Yo-sup, a mysterious boy who lives in dreams, and glimpses a future that lets him win big on a sports bet. While searching for Yo-sup again, he crosses paths with Min-a, a guarded high school girl. Struggling to understand one another, the three are drawn into a strange journey shaped by dreams and fate.

title: It Ends
overview: A group of recent grads head out on a late night drive for grub, hoping to enjoy one final hangout before their paths diverge. Instead, they accidentally turn onto a never-ending, two-lane hellscape surrounded by untold horrors and cosmic forces beyond their understanding. Cramped together inside a Jeep Cherokee and with the miles stretching infinitely ahead, they face a choice: embrace their new existence or fight to escape it.

title: Ice Skater
overview: A survival drama about an ice skater stranded on an ice floe at the Arctic Sea. When the ice floe starts to float towards south and melt, the ice skater must use all means necessary to survive.

title: Late Fame
overview: Legendary New York poet Ed Saxberger's forgotten works captivate an eccentric group of young creatives, reigniting his artistic passion. Their intrigue intertwines with the bewitching presence of actress Gloria.

title: Trial of Hein
overview: After 14 years away, Hein returns to his home village on a remote island, only to discover that the close-knit community no longer recognises him. Suspecting him to be an impostor, they demand a trial to determine his true identity.

title: Suffocation

As the curse reawakens, they must confront betrayal and despair while racing to uncover the truth and break the cycle of death, only to realize they are destined to become each other’s undoing.

title: Soulm8te

title: Sincerely, Victor
overview: A man, riddled with fear, enters the darkness of the forest. Followed by a shadowy figure, he must confront his mysterious past—or be consumed by the very thing that lured him there.

title: Robbed
overview: When a man falls into temptation and joins a robbery that goes terribly wrong, he descends into paranoia and tries to get rid of the money he believes is cursed.

title: Holy Father
overview: A horror thriller from the makers of 'Holy Ghost'

title: Anemoia
overview: Marcos has been living most of his life on autopilot, as a spectator, daydreaming of something better than his current situation, until the father who abandoned him as a child knocks on his door.

title: The Boy
overview: A transgender woman searches a Cornish coastal town for a lost boy but quickly finds herself in a race against the Law.

title: Bound By Lies
overview: Mira and Daisy thought one last score would be their way out. But when things go sideways and someone from their past comes looking for payback, they're left running with a bag full of cash, a broken promise, and nowhere to turn but each other. With love hanging by a thread and danger closing in, they have to decide if what they have is strong enough to survive, or if the escape they dreamed of was never real.

overview: Prince Alexander is ready to marry Olivia, a commoner. But when a bitter lord invokes ancient laws to block the union, Olivia, a romance writer, stumbles upon a hidden diary tucked within an old volume of history, revealing a long-lost truth that may be the key to saving her happily ever after.

title: Uncle
overview: When a man, quietly lost, suddenly finds himself caring for his best mate’s three-year-old son, a week of wandering, play and unexpected connection begins to unsettle the heaviness he carries.

title: Interlinked
overview: Haunted by the scars of childhood bullying, JJ is a young man trying to outrun the anger and isolation that have followed him into adulthood. Pushing his body to its limits and navigating the pressures of city life, he begins to find unexpected peace in Layla a connection that offers warmth, intimacy, and the possibility of healing.  But as memories begin to blur with the present, the fragile stability JJ has built starts to fracture. Moments repeat, emotions spiral, and the line between past and reality grows increasingly uncertain. Through a fragmented journey of rage, vulnerability, and longing, JJ is forced to confront the parts of himself he has spent years trying to bury.  As the story unfolds, the truth behind JJ’s experience slowly emerges revealing a devastating portrait of trauma, perception, and the fragile ways the mind protects itself when pain goes unheard.

overview: In the future, three Chinese astronauts, on their way back to Earth, encountered a complicated situation and lost contact with the ground. At the moment of crisis, they received an electronic signal, and their destiny will be completely changed by a mysterious code hidden in this signal.

title: Give It Up
overview: A privileged young man attempts to foray into the world of outrage comedy, but can't finish a set without getting brutalized.

title: Faust

With the help of samurai’s and good luck, they come out on top.

overview: Part one of a two-part finale. Daniel Chapman is back, and this time he's brought company. With his rebooted mission to bring the Last Reality to fruition in progress, Izz Fury's newly-formed Reality Warriors must band together to put an end to his deluded antics. The stakes have never been higher - the Triesverse ends here.

They are hunted by the Abnormal Defense Force, paramilitary police that specialize in ruthlessly exterminating ‘freaks‘ like them. Mary is fueled by revenge, determined to find the ADF officer who killed her first child.

A terrifying roar shakes the central station, while six strangers remain trapped in a cabin just steps from hell. Isolated from the world in a claustrophobic space of just a few square meters, tensions rise to the limit as air runs out and help fails to arrive...

title: The Glitter Fades
overview: After an impulsive decision to steal a watch, Matthew, a young man stuck working at a dry cleaner, is pulled into a chain of encounters that force him to confront who he is and who he wants to become.

overview: With her brother, Sang-hee visits her mother on Jeju Island. It’s been 10 years. Her mother's restaurant has become a hit. Her stepfather is making a film about a "grass tomb". His daughter has just started painting. Previously unknown facts, needless advice and cheap compliments are passed back and forth. On the morning of her departure, the other family members watch one of Sang-hee’s films.

title: Teenieping: Legend of the Whale Heartstone
Donkey Princess
overview: Diana is the princess of an ancient kingdom. Her father, King Arthur, forbids love. When Diana falls in love with Lalo, he banishes him. Using a magical bracelet, Diana travels to other worlds in search of her love. Discovering that her father manipulates her decisions, she must face her fears and change her destiny.

title: Trustor
overview: For the first time since 1997, Joachim Posener finally emerges from hiding and allows himself to be interviewed about his life and the Trustor affair. Twenty-seven years ago, he disappeared without a trace, and ever since, he has been on the international most wanted list. Now, Karin af Klintberg searches for him to find out how he lives and where he's been hiding all these years. But perhaps above all, to uncover what everyone is wondering: Was he guilty? Through new and opposing testimonies from never-before-heard voices, Karin simultaneously continues the search for the truth about the coup. How could five people swindle 600 million kr and still go free? And where did the money actually go?

overview: Explores the rise, impact, and enduring mythology of Aziz Shavershian – “Zyzz” – the unlikely internet icon whose transformation from anonymous teenager to global symbol of fitness culture reshaped how a generation defines influencers, identity, and self-invention.

title: Nimrods
overview: Three friends journey from Kansas City to Los Angeles, mistakenly believing that their band is opening for Green Day on New Year’s Eve.

title: Tiket Sehala
overview: Alif, Putri and Taqy, three Malaysians trapped in a human trafficking syndicate in South Korea, show the dark reality of labor exploitation and the struggle to return home.

title: Blue Lock
overview: A secret training program is established by the Japan Football Union to scout the world’s greatest striker after several years of defeat for the national team. Three hundred high school players gather at a remote facility to compete in ruthless trials where only one will emerge as the world’s greatest and most egoistic striker. The price of failure is absolute: those eliminated are permanently banned from ever joining the National Team.

title: Tomorrow a Long Time Ago
overview: In the turmoil of German reunification, Patty loses her job, loses her friend Jelena and disappears into the historic forest of the Kyffhäuser mountains. When she reappears in the nearby town thirty years later, barely aged, Jelena follows her ghostly apparition into the historical landscape of an East German present.

title: Super Troopers 3
overview: When Farva’s wildly over-the-top Indian engagement to Thorny’s sister spirals into chaos, the Super Troopers must navigate Thorny’s schemes to break up the relationship, while trying to crack a pernicious new drug ring  — all to save the day and maybe the wedding itself.

title: Everytime
overview: A tragedy brings a mother, daughter, and teenage boy together. Struggling with blame and forgiveness, the unlikely trio take a trip to Tenerife  for a family holiday that never happened. Under the glow of the sun,  past and present quietly start to overlap.

title: KikoRiki: Through the Universes
overview: Krosh and the Hedgehog find an unusual device in Chamomile Valley that takes them into a game about the future, where they are ordinary children on a spaceship flying to Mars. Adventures begin when the characters realize that this is not a game at all.

title: Ketticè
overview: Explores the dynamics between two local sixteen-year-olds, Ketty and Giulio, who together build an exclusive friendship, a shared refuge in their search for freedom, away from the judging eye of the adult world.

title: Sundown
overview: Three generations of women reunite in a remote cabin to avenge a loved one's death, only to discover their captive isn't who he seems to be, and his family is closing in, waiting for sundown.

title: Hearing
overview: Ninh is a mechanic that installs decibel meters in public spaces. Sound levels rise in his work and life, becoming a warning for matters of the heart.

title: Greta & Le Favole Vere
overview: Nine-year-old Greta loves making Christmas decorations with her babysitter, Katy. She believes so strongly in Santa Claus that she decides to deliver a letter to her neighbor, Nicola, who leads her to believe he is Santa's personal assistant. Of course, Nicola has been lying; when Greta exposes the truth, he confesses that he has no connection to Santa Claus. To make amends, Nicola—a talented illustrator—draws an animated fairy tale for her that will change her life.

title: Paradeisa
overview: When 12-year-old Lou’s narcissistic artist father, Edgar, realises his money is running out - he comes up with the absurd and morbid idea of ​​faking his own death.

title: Rehmat
overview: Follows three interconnected stories in present-day Punjab: a woman hiding a wounded stranger from police, a family coping with a disappearance, and an elderly man who returns from England claiming to be God.

title: Sweet Milk Lake
overview: When Jake, a 26-year-old trans man introvert, is mistaken by his estranged and dying father for his cis alpha twin brother, Sam, the opportunity to be 'one of the boys' and be easily accepted by his father derails his drive to self-actualise until the weight of the lie becomes heavier than his need for the truth.

title: The Days Off
overview: In the near future, during an endless summer break and with a solar eclipse approaching, 12-year-old Bego struggles to find her place within her family and among girls her age. As the moon “eclipses” animals and people around her, Bego meets REN__, an online friend, and through her discovers “shifting,” a practice in which teenagers believe they can access other realities through lucid dreaming.

title: Hill 338
overview: New comedy film inspired by the Israeli classic "Halfon Hill Doesn't Answer", released to celebrate its 50th anniversary. Somewhere in the Great Rift Valley stands a small, forgotten, and seemingly useless military base. When the Chinese government offers the state of Israel an enormous sum of cash to lay the path of their new Silk Road through it, all that seems to be done is to shut this base down. Ran Shem Tov, a "disassembly officer" who was deployed to command due to "military streamlining needs", is recruited for this mission. But the thing Ran and the heads of the IDF don't know is that an old bunker was built beneath the base, for which no one remembers the cause of construction. Lately, strange things have been happening in it, which delay the base's shutdown. These events bring all soldiers together against internal and external forces.

title: At Night
overview: After an abortion, a woman roams the streets, engaging in a sequence of understated encounters bathed in the glow of neon lights.

title: MAJU (Jejak Pahit si Kembang Gula)
overview: Mr. Wira is a teacher and scout leader for a group of his students. They plan to survey the location of the Scout Jamboree in Segosari village. Bagas, a big fan of the popular candy variety at that time, did not join his teacher and friends to visit the Village Head's house. Bagas was feeling unwell and just waited in the car. Upon returning from the Village Head's house, Bagas disappeared. The presence of Adit, a village boy who often gets bullied by other children, becomes an important key to finding Bagas.

title: Kado untuk Ibu
overview: Faris, a firefighter expecting his first child, cancels his trip to the hospital to be with his wife because he has to help Ara find a birthday present for her mother. Their journey becomes an exciting adventure that teaches many good deeds and the meaning of unexpected loss.

title: Wandering Trees
overview: In an unnamed but recognizable northern Sardinia the destinies of three families intertwine, clashing and meeting, losing each other and finding each other again. Three very different families: the Arca, the Nonne and the Branca. Piero and Giuliano Arca, father and son, live alone beyond the edge of the city in a farmhouse full of injured animals that they collect and treat.

title: The Violinist
overview: It is Singapore in the late 1930s. Kai and Fei are childhood friends and aspiring violinists. When Japan invades Malaya in 1941, Kai chooses to forgo his music career to join the anti-Japanese forces. After the war Kai goes missing. Determined to find him, Fei performs all over Southeast Asia, all the while seeking any news of Kai. Yet, as time fades, Fei has to decide if she must find her own music to define the remaining years of her life.

title: Viana – The Legend of the Golden Hearts
overview: In the north of medieval Portugal, the beautiful Ana falls in love with Thomas, a poor artisan. Her father immediately forbids their union, demanding that his daughter’s suitors produce a jewel as proof of their nobility. But the young couple refuse to give up. With the help of their faithful companions, the generosity of the townswomen and the talent of a mysterious jewellery maker, Ana and Thomas will face many challenges out of love, including the powerful and evil Duke of Aragon.

title: The House on the Moon
overview: Chang Er, a fairy maiden, embarks on a journey to the dark side of the moon to search for her lover Ho Yi, a sun-shooting archer who vanished on his quest to save the dying sun.

title: Robound

title: Milk
overview: When a young man disappears from a 19th century farming community, the Devil himself intervenes.

overview: Elene and Andro discover each other among thousands of protesters; with the desire to meet one another they stay at the demonstration that grows violent and gets dispersed by rubber bullets and tear gas.

In order to rehabilitate herself, she uses the outsider punk Rudi, who wants to attack a Nazi pub. But both end up fighting a battle for belonging - who will be left standing?

title: The Tinderbox Against the Magic Well
overview: Based on a story by H.C. Andersen, with new magical heroes, terrifying “woodpunk” robot dogs, real puppet theater, songs & dance numbers. Little Hans, a kind itinerant storyteller, opens his magic box, takes out his puppets, and, together with his spectators, creates a new fairytale. But not every character obeys the puppet master’s strings. The truth of the fairytale breaks everyday rules: here loyalty and friendship make miracles; love destroys the strongest magic spells; and a song wins a war!

title: National Seating
overview: Pleas Everson Sr. waxes poetically about his history of employment.

overview: Ingeborg and Adam are partners in life and at work. They are visionary hand surgeons who love being in control. She loves stealing objects, whereas he wants nothing more than to be her object. After an accident, she is forced to slow down and accept the help of a young, enigmatic woman named Gaia. As Ingeborg develops new obsessions, Adam begins searching for his own object of desire.

title: Brave New Love
overview: Hypnotherapist Kate lives with her husband, Orla, and their daughter, Athena, while simultaneously maintaining a deeply romantic – and highly secret – relationship with Andreas. As a role model to her daughter, she struggles to navigate her existential quest – a journey filled with body fluids, intimacy, Greek mythology, laughter, madness, and clumsiness.

title: Bruton
overview: A tragic accident leads Bryan Bruton on a wild and unforgettable experience within the Florida prison system.

title: ATEEZ: LIGHT THE WAY IN CINEMAS
overview: One day, a mysterious message arrives for ATEEZ, who had been spending a peaceful time in their hideout. At that moment, everything began to change. ATINY has vanished… As if under a spell, ATEEZ wanders through a dreamlike wasteland, into a collapsing world engulfed in flames, and the Dark City veiled in dense fog. Pursued by an unknown force, ATEEZ begins to fight back to find ATINY. Experience an intense immersion where every second counts with INCEPTION, an explosion of freedom and energy in the global hit BOUNCY (K-HOT CHILLI PEPPERS), and the pinnacle of refined charisma with Ice On My Teeth, now reimagined for the big screen. The world-class cinematic VR concert that captivated audiences around the globe has been fully refitted for cinemas, bringing ATEEZ's electrifying performances to life on the largest stage of all.

title: Manhunt
overview: Follows two young men who embark on a road trip through Canada's northern frontier to escape their dead-end lives as their reality dissolves between digital fantasy and offline existence.

overview: His father unknown and abandoned by his mother, Owusu’s only caregiver is his alleged half-aunt, Yaa. Their sacred bond is cut short upon her death giving birth to Adobea.

title: Toko Perlengkapan Mayat
overview: Daeng Sarro, the owner of a mortuary supplies business, asks his children and grandchildren to come and stay at his house in a remote village after his wife dies, until the mourning period is over. However, due to urgent matters, Rahma must return to the city, while her children remain at home. Day by day, various mysterious events begin to haunt Daeng Sarro's grandchildren.

title: The Riverbank
overview: Izaquiel, black and gay, has been working in an old street cinema for a few years. The cinema's situation is not going well and its owner finds himself pressured into subletting it to an evangelical congregation. That's when Izaquiel finds himself drawn into a spiral of persecution and control by the new tenants, religious extremists.

title: Still Standing, Still Stuffed
overview: Once beloved TV puppet stars from the golden age of children’s television have long been forgotten. Decades later, they struggle to survive in the absurd realities of the modern world. When they reunite, the old friends set out on an impossible mission — to stage a comeback.  Blending sharp satire with warm nostalgia and pulsing with 80s synthwave vibes, this wild, heartfelt comedy explores aging icons, lost dreams, and the hilarious quest to stay relevant in a world that has moved on.

title: Far From the Trees
overview: A woman who travels to Peru and, continuing her grandfather’s legacy, tries to create a sound map of languages that are disappearing.

overview: The story of Sapphire as she overcomes loss and trauma to protect those she holds dear.

Fate reunites them tonight in the heart of Taipei, but they only have a few hours to uncover the secrets hidden in each other’s hearts.

overview: "Jurassic Park" meets "Dr. Strangelove". It's a reprise and fifth feature spin of the 1978 Cult Classic "Attack of the Killer Tomatoes," the franchise that went from 80s midnight screenings to help launch the Fox Children's TV Network.

overview: A Fourth of July dinner turns deadly when a nuclear strike is announced. A helicopter is coming for Senator Wilde—but only three others can join him. Guests fight to prove who deserves a seat before time runs out.

overview: In 1952, a train journey to Oslo becomes a battleground when a journalist and her husband confront a man who claims to have saved thousands during WWII. As questions arise about his true motives, the line between hero and opportunist blurs.

One day, a temporary teacher named Ryo appears. Yuri finds herself constantly seeing traces of Akira in Ryo's casual gestures and words. Though confused by her wavering heart, she desperately tries to suppress her feelings for him, having resolved to love only Akira for the rest of her life.

title: DELIVERY BOY
overview: A young food delivery rider, who dreams of becoming a police officer, is forced to steal money to save his critically injured mother. Months later, when he discovers that the same man has been falsely accused of murder, he risks everything to save the life he once unknowingly changed forever.
